'''Giant coyotes''', appearing in groups of two to ten in most savage [[biome]]s, are pack hunters that are bigger than [[elk]]s. Lacking the {{token|LARGE_PREDATOR|c}} token, they aren't very aggressive towards your dwarves.  Though they have a medium sized amount of [[meat|food]] returns, they do help a struggling fortress to get by.
